name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
one_liner: Type in a topic or a few keywords and it automatically writes a script, finds matching clips, adds subtitles and music, and hands you a finished short video.
buyer: A solo content creator or small social-media agency who needs to publish several short videos a day across TikTok/YouTube Shorts/Reels and can't script, shoot, and edit each one by hand.
business_use_cases: A 'faceless channel' operator runs a dozen niche YouTube Shorts channels (facts, quotes, finance tips) that this tool fully auto-generates daily, monetized via ad revenue.
A small marketing agency offers local businesses a 'done-for-you social video' package: client gives a topic each week, agency delivers 5 ready-to-post short videos.
A course or app creator turns their written lesson outlines into a stream of short promotional/explainer videos to drive traffic to the paid product.

money_ideas.idea: Run a network of niche auto-generated video channels and monetize through platform ad revenue and affiliate links.
Sell a 'weekly short-form video pack' subscription to small businesses who just supply a topic each week.

steal_this: Pick one tight niche (e.g. 'daily personal-finance tip') and this weekend set up an automated pipeline from this tool straight to a scheduled posting tool — let it run as a faceless channel for a month before touching it again.
